title: Redesign Mobile Word Info Experience
description: The word info modal/drawer is terrible on mobile. You have full creative freedom to redesign the layout and UX for mobile.

acceptanceCriteria.text: BROWSER TEST: Open current drawer on mobile (375px viewport)
Document what's wrong with current approach
Research mobile UI patterns (use WebSearch if helpful)
Redesign mobile word info experience (be creative!)
Must show: word, transliteration, Hebrew, English, learned state
Must be dismissable (Escape key, X button)
BROWSER TEST: Verify new design looks good and is usable on mobile
